lines.text: A river bridge, leading into the city. A message for each way.
This is the Sytronsoft Variable Message Display. High-brightness L E D signage for highways and cities.
Before dawn, a new message: right lane closed. Update messages remotely, from the web or an app.
Then the sun rises over the river. The display has automatic day and night brightness control.
Messages can also be scheduled. At the set time, the scheduled message comes up.
Highway traffic reads one board, city traffic the other. Signage for highways and smart cities.
Variable Message Display, by Sytronsoft. Innovate. Develop. Deliver. Visit sytronsoft dot com.
